metadata.title: Phase 1A.2b2-R2 exact terminal-effect source dispositions
metadata.scope: Additive source-only disposition of the 154 chains R1 left unestablished; accepted b2, R1, b1, and application code are unchanged.

normalizationRules: R2 membership is the exact set selected by R1's four unestablished assessment values.
Absent or unconfirmed local route/method mappings remain explicit source states; they are not explained by an assumed external backend.
Operation evidence is bounded source observation. Cross-cutting auth, RLS, organization, and telemetry operations are not promoted to business effects.
A terminal effect not established by the available source trace is explicitly labeled as unestablished, not guessed.
No runtime response, committed database write, provider success, authorization correctness, organization isolation, audit completeness, or product readiness is inferred.
